name: Stryker CDR (CAD Hedged)
summary: Stryker Corp. is a medical technology company providing products and services aimed at improving patient and healthcare outcomes. It reports MedSurg and Neurotechnology, and Orthopaedics and Spine segments. MedSurg and Neurotechnology covers surgical equipment and navigation, patient handling, emergency medical equipment, stroke treatment products, and endoscopic and communications systems.
